exposure: maternally derived large deletion of the complete H19-differentially methylated region (H19-DMR; imprinting control region-1 [ICR1])
deletion of the whole H19 gene
deletion of large parts of the distal enhancer region within the imprinting cluster-1 (IC1)
outcome: highly elevated insulin-like growth factor 2 (IGF2) expression
cohort: A female patient presenting with macrosomia, macroglossia, organomegaly, and extensive bilateral nephroblastomatosis.
finding: A large maternal deletion encompassing the H19 gene and complete ICR1 demonstrated transcriptional consequences on IGF2 in addition to methylation effects, resulting in severe overgrowth and multiple tumors in a Beckwith-Wiedemann syndrome patient.
followup_time: At least 12 months of age (until tumor manifestation)
